reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through our expense app and it works well enough. I don't want another bot in the group and another sheet to look after next to the system we already pay for.
objection: Does it really catch a duplicate when my staff photograph the same nota twice, or is it just a receipt-to-table bot? And if it only writes to a Google Sheet, my bookkeeper still has to put everything into the app we already use, so that's double work.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed straight into the app my bookkeeper uses and I could watch it flag a real duplicate from last month's chat history during the free trial.
